info.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
info.synopsis: La Chidori High è una scuola maschile prevalentemente frequentata da studenti di bassa estrazione sociale e con voti pessimi; la Kikyo Girls' High invece è una scuola femminile che ha come studentesse le figlie di famiglie ricche e prestigiose. Queste due scuole, che sono situate una di fianco all'altra, sono in continua disputa fra loro. Rintaro Tsumugi è uno studente del secondo anno della Chidori dall'aspetto da delinquente, ma dal carattere gentile, che un giorno, mentre sta aiutando nella pasticceria di famiglia, incontra Kaoruko Waguri. I due vanno subito d'accordo anche perché Kaoruko non sembra dare importanza all'aspetto del ragazzo, ma questa sensazione di pace viene rapidamente turbata quando Rintaro scopre che la ragazza frequenta la Kikyo. Questa rivelazione segna l'inizio di una faticosa storia fra i due, mentre lottano contro le limitazioni imposte dalle loro scuole e dall'ambiente circostante, nel tentativo di trovare la loro strada.

episodes.title: Rintaro and Kaoruko
episodes.synopsis: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

episodes.title: Chidori and Kikyo
episodes.synopsis: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

episodes.title: A Kind Person
episodes.synopsis: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

episodes.title: Warmth of the Heart
episodes.synopsis: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

episodes.title: Premonition of a New Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

episodes.title: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
episodes.synopsis: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

episodes.title: Coolest Guy Ever
episodes.synopsis: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

episodes.title: The Meaning of These Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

episodes.title: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
episodes.synopsis: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

episodes.title: Summer Storm
episodes.synopsis: To prepare for their finals, the six Chidori and Kikyo students hold a joint study session. Later, Shohei makes a sharp observation about Rintaro.

episodes.title: A Morsel of Warmth
episodes.synopsis: Kaoruko's birthday is in two weeks, and Rintaro is unsure of a gift until his mother gives valuable advice. Can he bake the perfect cake for her?

episodes.title: Bewilderment at the Beachside
episodes.synopsis: While everyone else is having fun at the beach, Subaru seems down. When prodded, she reveals her worries and makes a request to the four Chidori boys.

episodes.title: Kaoruko and Rintaro
episodes.synopsis: With things still left unspoken between them, Rintaro arranges to meet Kaoruko and express his true feelings. Kaoruko has her own thoughts to share.
